svg.title: How Upstream Inspektor Gadget Works: OCI Catalog & Control Matrix
svg.desc: Diagram showing OCI gadget packaging, the distinction between official stock gadgets (including the four pinned gadgets trace_open, trace_exec, traceloop, advise_seccomp), third-party community gadgets, and IG operators/trust layers, followed by a three-bucket coverage matrix across the five Shirudo controls.
svg.text: How Upstream Inspektor Gadget Works: OCI Catalog & Control Matrix
Separating official stock gadgets, third-party community gadgets, and what IG can observe, advise, or not cover
1. OCI Gadget Packaging & Artifact Hub Catalog Taxonomy (Kind 22)
Official Stock Gadgets
inspektor-gadget/gadgets/*
• Built & signed in-tree on GHCR
• Artifact Hub: verified_publisher
true, official false (0.57.0 listing
can lag v0.58.0 runtime pin)
• Four pinned in lab/pins.json:
trace_open, trace_exec,
traceloop, advise_seccomp
Third-Party Community
External OCI Registries
• Authored outside upstream repo
with ig image build
• Bundles eBPF ELF + gadget.yaml
+ optional WASM module
• Requires user-supplied keys;
not evaluated in this benchmark
IG Runner & Trust Layers
ig / gadgettracermanager
• Operators enrich events (oci,
ebpf, sockets, paths, K8s)
• Archive: release attestation
• OCI: default cosign vs IG key
• Pinned exact OCI digests in
lab/pins.json (distinct layers)
2. Stock v0.58.0 Inspektor Gadget Coverage Across the Five Controls (Not All 3rd-Party)
Bucket A: Can Observe Live
Process Execs, File Opens & Syscall Flight Recording
• Pinned trace_open correlated exclusive opens of canary.php (1), canary.txt (1), and ENOENT (1); real PHP-FPM
wrote both files (open/write/close median 14,722 ns OFF vs 28,475 ns ON; 95,328 ns first CLI line median).
• Pinned trace_exec observed 1 new JVM launch; pinned traceloop matched 18 AF_UNIX and 18 AF_ALG unbound
socket returns (3 warmups + 15 measured; AF_UNIX 2,964/9,751/2,989 ns; AF_ALG 2,483/9,347/2,848 ns).
• Reference source check: v0.58.0 trace_lsm (not pinned in suite) exports only time, process, and hook name
(includes file_open, omits socket_create/socket_connect, has no AF or errno field, and always returns 0).
Bucket B: Can Advise / Audit Policy
Seccomp Profile Generation & Audit Log Streaming
• Pinned advise_seccomp generated a candidate seccomp profile (default SCMP_ACT_ERRNO, allows_openat=true,
allows_socket=true, applied=false). Reference v0.58.0 audit_seccomp streams existing seccomp filter logs.
• Neither advise_seccomp nor audit_seccomp denies syscalls itself; blocking requires applying an external
seccomp profile in the container runtime or using an inline kernel LSM shield.
Bucket C: Not Covered by Stock IG
Inline Kernel Refusal, Inside-JVM Guards & TPM State Sealing
• Synchronous in-kernel blocking: no stock v0.58.0 gadget returns -EACCES (on canary.php) or -EPERM
(on unbound AF_ALG socket creation) inside a kernel LSM hook.
• Inside-JVM controls (java-base64 & java-sql-inj): stock IG can trace JVM execs and file opens, but
does not attach bytecode guards to Base64$Decoder.decode0 or JDBC Statement SQL queries inside the JVM.
• In-kernel keyring sealing & hardware TPM state attestation (basic): GitHub release attestation (release/v0.2),
default cosign publisher verification, and OCI digest pins operate in userspace and do not seal
the kernel .bpf keyring, deny unsigned host BPF loads globally, or extend vTPM NV index 0x01818E00.
